blends.name: Overlord of the Wombat Realm – Season 28 Edition
blends.desc: Rising from the depths of the dungeon’s darkest chambers, the Overlord reigns supreme. Empowered by the essence of 28 seasons, this Wombat commands unrivaled might, reshaping the balance of power underground. With every treasure unearthed, its dominion grows, granting its bearer extraordinary strength and influence over the dungeon's riches. Only the worthy can wield the Overlord’s unmatched power—are you ready to rise?

blends.name: Sidekick Milo claim
blends.desc: Get your Milo dungeongemsx Sidekick if you have the dungeongemsx Sidekick Claim Orb.

blends.name: Petrified Christmas Wreath Level 5
blends.desc:
Through an ancient and irreversible ritual, the Christmas Wreath Level 5 can be petrified, transforming into a Non-Tradable Token (NTT). While it will no longer be transferable or tradable, this process unlocks a hidden potential, increasing its Mining Power (MP) from 1500 to 1700. This petrified relic becomes a permanent fixture in your dungeon arsenal, offering unmatched power and stability for your mining endeavors.

Warning: Once petrified, the Christmas Wreath Level 5 cannot be moved, or traded. Choose wisely before undergoing this transformation.

blends.name: Worm Wombatium Victory Blend
blends.desc: Forged from a mix of resilience, flame, and triumph, the Worm Wombatium represents the unyielding spirit of the dungeon's depths. The moss provides enduring vitality, the fire fuels unstoppable energy, and the victory signifies hard-earned triumph.

blends.name: WUF-fle Third Edition

Enter the NFT-powered WUF-fle!

This blend if your lucky ticket to getting a share of 5B $WUF. Put your Wombatiums in and see if you get a paw-sitive result!

blends.name: Banker’s Set Grandmaster Pack Blend
blends.desc: Boost your wealth accumulation with the Banker’s Grandmaster Pack. Blend 3 Banker’s Master Packs with 1 Cat Wombatium to create a pack of 8 Mythic items, each designed to enhance your financial strategy. With 15,000 MP, dominate the Dungeon Master economy!

blends.name: Professor’s Set Grandmaster Pack Blend
blends.desc: Unlock unparalleled knowledge with the Professor's Grandmaster Pack. Blend 3 Professor’s Master Packs with 1 Cat Wombatium to obtain a collection of 8 Mythic items, all designed to boost your wisdom. Empower your strategy with 15,000 MP and lead the intellectual charge!

blends.name: Sprinter’s Set Grandmaster Pack Blend
blends.desc: Race ahead with the Sprinter's Grandmaster Pack! Combine 3 Sprinter’s Master Packs with 1 Cat Wombatium to unlock a powerful pack containing 8 Mythic items. With 15,000 MP on your side, your speed will be unmatched in Dungeon Master!

blends.name: Collector’s Set Grandmaster Pack Blend
blends.desc: Take your collection game to the next level with the Collector's Grandmaster Pack. Blend 3 Collector’s Master Packs and 1 Cat Wombatium to create a pack of 8 Mythic items, each tailored to boost your collecting skills. Gain an incredible 15,000 MP and secure your place as the ultimate Collector!

blends.name: Cook’s Set Grandmaster Pack Blend
blends.desc: Unleash the full potential of the Cook's Set with this exclusive Grandmaster Pack. Blend 3 Cook’s Master Packs with 1 Cat Wombatium to craft a pack filled with 8 Mythic items designed to elevate your cooking prowess. With a Mining Power of 15,000 MP, it’s the ultimate boost for culinary champions!
